content: Claude Code MCP annotation behavior (OFFICIAL docs code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp + agent-sdk/custom-tools, read directly; CORRECTS prior community claim): readOnlyHint:true -> calls run in PARALLEL with other read-only calls; readOnlyHint OR idempotentHint:true -> Claude Code may repeat a pending call ONCE on a new connection after disconnect (HTTP/claude.ai connector). 'Annotations are metadata, not enforcement.' Defaults: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint true, idempotentHint false, openWorldHint true. NO documented auto-approval from standard hints; anthropics/claude-code#87452 is an OPEN feature request asking for hint-based permission processing; plan-mode silent read-only claim is community-only (jcodemunch PR#361). _meta anthropic/requiresUserInteraction:true forces prompt every call even bypassPermissions; _meta anthropic/maxResultSizeChars raises 50k-char persist-to-disk threshold up to 500k ceiling. Auto/plan mode: set destructiveHint:true explicitly on always_ask tools or the auto-mode classifier may approve them.
